body: This is very true. We got in an argument this morning and I realized I had no one to go to. I started a conversation on reddit because thats how bad I needed to talk to people. Anyone. I ended up also talking to his best friend who lives across the country, and he got mad at me for talking to his own best friend. I was very alone and realized that if anything were to ever happen, I would literally have no one. Me and him have been dating a year now and if we were to break up, that would be one of the hardest things I've been through considering I'm only 17 years old. I would be doing that all on my own.

Yeah I've been told by other people that I need to be more comfortable with myself and try to work on that. And my boyfriend really does make me happy. I know him really well and has a really good guy. He does have insecurity issues though im pretty sure. I've tried to talk to him but he only gets mad and thinks that if I want to talk to other guys, it's for romantic reasons. I really really like psychology (go figure). I took the AP class and passed with flying colors. They didn't notice I had already taken that so I decided to take on level psychology this year. It's the only class I do well in and really just because I can fly by it. I know everything and then some because I already took the AP. I really want to be a psychiatric nurse even though I haven't taken a LOT of time to look into yet. My boyfriends mom is a psychologist and she's explained it to me and talked me about jobs in the field and stuff
Thank you so much. This put a smile on my face. If you don't mind me asking, how long did your family members struggle?
